get_checkpointer: get the global sync checkpointer singleton for use with LangGraph graph compilation
reset_checkpointer: reset the sync checkpointer singleton and close any open backend connections
checkpointer_context: use a one-shot checkpointer context manager that creates and destroys its own connection
sync_checkpointer_cm: create and tear down a sync checkpointer for memory, sqlite, or postgres backends
checkpointer_error_constants: reference the sqlite and postgres install error message constants for troubleshooting
